# C interop under Wine, on 64- and 32-bit Windows, in C and in Go, the
# program calling its own declarations as a Go program calling the wrappers
# does and as one calling C directly does.
#
# A callback Win32 calls is CALLBACK, which is __stdcall on 32-bit x86:
# #[c.static(convention="CALLBACK")] writes it into the function C is
# handed, which C takes at the typedef #[c.type] names with no cast (a
# __stdcall mismatch is an incompatible pointer to MinGW's i686 compiler),
# and Go hands C a static C function of that convention calling its export.
# A timer's procedure ticks once through SetTimer and the fixture's message
# loop, and a window procedure, handed to RegisterClassW by the fixture's C,
# answers a message SendMessageW sends, its WPARAM, LPARAM and LRESULT
# crossing as those types.
#
# A pointer in a message's LPARAM: #[c.type("LPARAM")] on a string, its
# UTF-16 alias, a ref to a C struct or a handle says C takes it as that
# integer, and the call casts it, in C (Go through a C function taking the
# pointer, so cgo keeps what it points to). WM_SETTEXT sets a window's text
# both ways and WM_GETTEXTLENGTH counts it; the fixture's own window
# procedure reads and writes a RECT handed by ref and answers whether an
# LPARAM is a window; and a WM_NOTIFY's LPARAM is cast back to the NMHDR it
# points to, whose members `field` reads.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt cgo=direct app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go --opt cgo=direct --opt arch=386 app.sngl
stdout 'ok +6 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import api "sngl:platform/win32/api"
import c "sngl:x/c"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

c.link(include="interop.h", sources=["interop.c", "interop.h"])

#[c.native("UINT_PTR")]
struct UINT_PTR = int

#[c.native("SetTimer")]
func _setTimer(h api.HWND, id UINT_PTR, ms api.UINT, #[c.type("TIMERPROC")] #[c.static(convention="CALLBACK")] tick func(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, id UINT_PTR, time api.DWORD)) UINT_PTR

#[c.native("KillTimer")]
func _killTimer(h api.HWND, id UINT_PTR) api.WINBOOL

#[c.native("DefWindowProcW")]
func _defProc(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, w api.WPARAM, l api.LPARAM) api.LRESULT

#[c.native("interop_window")]
func _window(#[c.type("WNDPROC")] #[c.static(convention="CALLBACK")] proc func(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, w api.WPARAM, l api.LPARAM) api.LRESULT) api.HWND

#[c.native("interop_pump")]
func _pump(h api.HWND, ms int) int

#[c.native("interop_stop")]
func _stop()

#[c.native("SendMessageW")]
func _sendWide(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, w api.WPARAM, #[c.type("LPARAM")] text c.utf16) api.LRESULT

#[c.native("SendMessageA")]
func _sendAnsi(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, w api.WPARAM, #[c.type("LPARAM")] text string) api.LRESULT

#[c.native("SendMessageW")]
func _sendRect(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, w api.WPARAM, #[c.type("LPARAM")] r ref[api.RECT]) api.LRESULT

#[c.native("SendMessageW")]
func _sendWindow(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, w api.WPARAM, #[c.type("LPARAM")] other api.HWND) api.LRESULT

#[c.native("interop_c_window")]
func _cWindow() api.HWND

#[c.native("interop_notify")]
func _notify(to api.HWND, code int)

#[c.native("NMHDR *")]
struct _Nmhdr {}

#[c.native("NMHDR *", cast)]
func _header(l api.LPARAM) _Nmhdr

#[c.native("NMHDR.code", field)]
func _code(h _Nmhdr) api.UINT

#[c.native("NMHDR.idFrom", field)]
func _from(h _Nmhdr) UINT_PTR

var noted = 0
var notedFrom = 0

var ticks = 0
var tickedId = 0

func _tick(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, id UINT_PTR, time api.DWORD) {
    ticks += 1
    tickedId = id
    _killTimer(h, id)
    _stop()
}

func _proc(h api.HWND, msg api.UINT, w api.WPARAM, l api.LPARAM) api.LRESULT {
    if msg == 1031 {
        return w * 2 + l
    }
    if msg == 78 {
        var hdr = _header(l)
        noted = _code(hdr)
        notedFrom = _from(hdr)
        return 0
    }
    return _defProc(h, msg, w, l)
}

ui.window(title="interop") {
    ui.text("interop")
}

func testATimerTicks(t test.Test) {
    var h = _window(_proc)
    _setTimer(h, 7, 10, _tick)
    t.assert(_pump(h, 5000) == 1)
    t.assert(ticks == 1)
    t.assert(tickedId == 7)
}

func testAWindowProcedureAnswers(t test.Test) {
    var h = _window(_proc)
    t.assert(api.SendMessage(h, 1031, 20, 2) == 42)
}

func testAStringIsAnLparam(t test.Test) {
    var h = _window(_proc)
    _sendWide(h, 12, 0, "héllo")
    t.assert(api.SendMessage(h, 14, 0, 0) == 5)
    _sendAnsi(h, 12, 0, "abc")
    t.assert(api.SendMessage(h, 14, 0, 0) == 3)
}

func testAStructIsReadAndWrittenThroughAnLparam(t test.Test) {
    var h = _cWindow()
    var r = api.RECT{left=4, top=5, right=0, bottom=0}
    var got = _sendRect(h, 1032, 0, &r)
    t.assert(got == 9)
    t.assert(r.right == 8)
    t.assert(r.bottom == 6)
}

func testAWindowIsAnLparam(t test.Test) {
    var h = _cWindow()
    t.assert(_sendWindow(h, 1034, 0, _window(_proc)) == 1)
}

func testANotifyIsReadThroughItsLparam(t test.Test) {
    var h = _window(_proc)
    _notify(h, 1234)
    t.assert(noted == 1234)
    t.assert(notedFrom == 5)
}
-- interop.h --
#include <windows.h>

// A message-only window of a class whose procedure is proc.
HWND interop_window(WNDPROC proc);

// Runs h's messages until interop_stop is called, answering 1, or ms pass,
// answering 0.
int interop_pump(HWND h, int ms);
void interop_stop(void);

// A message-only window whose procedure is the fixture's own: 1032 reads
// the RECT its LPARAM points to and writes it, and 1034 answers whether its
// LPARAM is a window.
HWND interop_c_window(void);

// Sends to a WM_NOTIFY from window 5 carrying code.
void interop_notify(HWND to, int code);
-- interop.c --
#include "interop.h"

static int stopped;

HWND interop_window(WNDPROC proc) {
	static int n;
	wchar_t name[32];
	wsprintfW(name, L"interop%d", n++);
	WNDCLASSW wc = {0};
	wc.lpfnWndProc = proc;
	wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
	wc.lpszClassName = name;
	if (!RegisterClassW(&wc)) {
		return NULL;
	}
	return CreateWindowExW(0, name, L"", 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, HWND_MESSAGE, NULL, wc.hInstance, NULL);
}

int interop_pump(HWND h, int ms) {
	DWORD start = GetTickCount();
	stopped = 0;
	while (!stopped && GetTickCount() - start < (DWORD)ms) {
		MSG m;
		if (PeekMessageW(&m, h, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE)) {
			DispatchMessageW(&m);
		} else {
			Sleep(1);
		}
	}
	return stopped;
}

void interop_stop(void) {
	stopped = 1;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK c_proc(HWND h, UINT msg, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
	switch (msg) {
	case 1032: {
		RECT *r = (RECT *)l;
		r->right = r->left * 2;
		r->bottom = r->top + 1;
		return r->left + r->top;
	}
	case 1034:
		return IsWindow((HWND)l) ? 1 : 0;
	}
	return DefWindowProcW(h, msg, w, l);
}

HWND interop_c_window(void) {
	return interop_window(c_proc);
}

void interop_notify(HWND to, int code) {
	NMHDR nm = {0};
	nm.hwndFrom = to;
	nm.idFrom = 5;
	nm.code = (UINT)code;
	SendMessageW(to, WM_NOTIFY, 5, (LPARAM)&nm);
}
